case_name: Deputy Commissioner Of Income Tax vs M/S U.P Awas Evam Vikas Parishad

parties.respondent_defendant: M/S U.P Awas Evam Vikas Parishad

facts_of_case: Assessee filed appeals against separate orders of learned CIT(A) dated 21/02/2019, 21/02/2019 and 26/11/2019 respectively. Revenue also filed Cross Objections.

legal_principles.principle: Entities which carry on commercial activities will not be eligible for exemption under Section 11 or 10 (23C) of Act, 1961.
legal_principles.held: Whether an entity is carrying on activities in the nature of trade, commerce or business is a question of fact which will be decided based on the nature, scope, extent and frequency of activities.
use_in: case type: registration of charitable trusts

legal_principles.principle: An Assessee, if engaged in any activity in the nature of trade, commerce or business or renders any service in relation to trade, commerce or business, it would not be entitled to claim that its object is 'charitable purpose'.
legal_principles.held: In such a case, object of general public utility will be only a mask or a device to hide the true purpose, which is trade, commerce or business, or rendering of any service in relation to trade, commerce or business.
cited_cases: Morice Versus Bishop of Durham (1805) 10 Ves Jr 522
use_in: case type: registration of charitable trusts
